note: Adversarial cases built from golden_qa.json and data/papers (N13). Each case reuses a golden question; the script builds the passages.

groups.noisy: the true evidence passage plus irrelevant passages from other papers
groups.ssli: the true passage plus look-alike passages (high word overlap, different paper or topic)
groups.counterfactual: the true passage with its numbers altered; a faithful system must not repeat the true value as if unchanged, and must cite the altered passage or abstain
